title: W64 total repository census and penetration proof
purpose: Quantify active, dormant, duplicate, stale, and unknown assets across the repository before release credit is promoted.

P1_primary: Enumerate tracked assets by category: source, SSOT, schema, workflow, script, binary, generated output, docs, and legacy material.
Bind every registry path to an existing file or explicitly mark it unresolved.
P2_reverse_pressure: Detect duplicate or competing SSOTs, schemas, runtimes, and release outputs.
Prevent stale ABACUS version trees, old bridge proposals, generated outputs, and Docker leftovers from inflating active architecture coverage.
Classify unknowns conservatively until import, workflow, or registry evidence proves activity.
P3_receipt: Emit a unified W64 census receipt with counts, duplicate candidates, unresolved references, and follow-up consolidation queue.
Require exact-head CI and machine-readable output before DoV uplift.
Declare release-critical unknowns as blockers, not neutral inventory.

acceptance_gates: Every counted asset has path, category, classification, and evidence basis.
No registry path is silently ignored.
Duplicate authority candidates are reported before consolidation.
non_claims: Does not delete or migrate assets.
Does not claim architectural penetration from generated outputs alone.
Does not promote W64 until census output is executable and exact-head green.
